retrieved_product_sources.title: README.md
retrieved_product_sources.text: The **Person detection confidence** slider ranges from 5% to 95%, initially 50%. Lower values admit more detections and possible false positives. Changes update Preview and set the threshold for newly opened Live/Review runs. Paused frames are checked automatically. The overlay uses source timestamps and preserves the video aspect ratio, including letterboxing. Use the player’s **Full screen** button to keep overlays visible in fullscreen. Labels show confidence percentages without person numbers. Display smoothing does not establish identities or change saved detection evidence.

retrieved_product_sources.title: README.md
retrieved_product_sources.text: The main interface starts on **Preview**. Choose a library video or **Open video**, then play, pause and seek normally. Person boxes and confidence scores appear directly over the playing video, with one confidence slider below it. Library thumbnails help identify each recording; they also appear in the Live/Review video picker. Preview works with AI off and does not start AI review, send footage to a provider or consume an AI allowance. Local CV checks run serially with a short lookahead buffer. Nearby, unambiguous boxes blend between sampled positions for smoother movement; new detections appear only at their observed time. Boxes clear on seeks, confidence changes or when older than half a second. This is sampled detection, not tracking or analysis of every frame. Browser playback requires a supported codec, such as H.264 MP4.

retrieved_product_sources.text:
| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `delegate_specialist(task)` | Boss only: typed question/owner/observation IDs, initial assessment or targeted follow-up |
| `search_safety_sources(query, jurisdiction, topic, limit, broaden)` | Specialist: at most five discovery previews, exact-citation lookup first, otherwise FTS5/BM25; no citation permission from previews |
| `fetch_sources(source_ids)` | Specialist: exact clauses plus parent context and one-hop related context, without truncating requirements |
| `get_site_rules(site_id, topic)` | Specialist/challenger: matching versioned site rules; no invented thresholds |
| `read_source(source_id, section)` | Challenger: assigned exact excerpt subject to evidence size limit |
| `get_evidence` / `sample_frames` / `get_camera_context` | Observer/challenger evidence functions retain their existing scope and camera limits |
